newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah down on liquidity, demonstration.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah down on liquidity, demonstration.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah was lower against the dollar in late trading on Thursday amid ample rupiah liquidity and an opposition political demonstration in Jakarta, dealers said.
"The demonstration that came amid the ample liquidity and a hike in the central bank's fixing rate further weakened sentiment on the rupiah," one foreign bank dealer said.

The dealer said the market was cautious over any potential tension during the protest on Thursday by hundreds of supporters of ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), Megawati Sukarnoputri.
One-month swap was at 16.00/16.50, two at 32.25/33.00, three at 45.00/46.00. Six-months swap was last at 89.00/89.50 points.
Overnight swap was last at 0.43/0.45. Tomorrow and today rupiah were last quoted at 2,355.45/56.60 and 2,353.75/54.25, respectively.
